guide_config.masked:
# Configuration

Install first ([installation]()). Every setting can also come from the
environment ([variables]()).

## TLS & certificates (v2)

Certificates are read from `~/.acme/certs`. Log TLS errors at debug level, see
[Logging]().

## Logging

`log_level` is one of debug, info, warn, error. Variables override it, see
[environment variables]().

## Environment variables

`ACME_LOG_LEVEL`, `ACME_PROXY`.

guide_deploy.masked:
# Deploying

You need a working [install]() and [TLS set up]().
The on-call steps are in the [runbook]().

## Rolling back

`acme deploy --rollback` restores the previous release.

reference_cli.masked:
# CLI reference

## Global flags

`--proxy URL`, `--verbose`. Verbosity maps to [log levels]().

## `build` command

`acme build [--release]`. See the [build command]() for caching.

ops_runbook.masked:
# On-call runbook

1. If a deploy fails, [roll back]().
2. Check the [FAQ]() for known issues.
3. Behind a proxy? See [proxy settings]().
